counts_basis: Counts are grep line hits in docs/bgitems.txt (creatures 27, weapons 32, gear 19), not distinct verified records. docs/siitems.txt gave 28 creature-word and 32 armour-word hits. Creature and weapon data tables (monster.dat, weapons.dat, armor.dat) are absent from the box, so no record counts exist. Classes and zones: none read as records.
halves_read: Engine/client half: combat.cc, actors.cc, monsters.cc, effects.cc, shapes/shapeinf/*.cc (loaders), docs/bgitems.txt and docs/siitems.txt (name tables), data/exultmsg.txt (grep count only). Server half (server/, 9 files) listed only. Data pack half absent.

top_creatures.label: Splitting jelly
top_creatures.why: A blob that divides when struck and joins its neighbours visually at the edges.
top_creatures.keep: Split on a non-vulnerable hit with a 50 percent roll; neighbour-aware frame masks; bleed trail on move.
top_creatures.change: Cap total splits per encounter (no cap seen in lines read); add a size tier so the split reads at 375 wide.

top_creatures.label: Winged stone warrior ladder
top_creatures.why: Worker, warrior and noble read as tiers of one family; the flying variant adds a second axis.
top_creatures.keep: Role-tier ladder with a flying variant.

top_creatures.label: Dragon age ladder with undead form
top_creatures.why: Baby, adult and elder steps read at a glance; the skeletal form adds a second look.
top_creatures.keep: Three age steps plus one undead variant.
top_creatures.change: Our element (not ice) and our wing shape.

top_creatures.label: Teleporting caster
top_creatures.why: One escape move per creature, gated by a per-creature flag.
top_creatures.keep: Teleport only when the flag is set.

top_creatures.label: Summoner
top_creatures.why: One signature move that adds enemies to the fight.
top_creatures.change: Our summon count and our spawn cap (row 23 rules).

top_creatures.label: Invisible stalker
top_creatures.why: Starts unseen; only see-invisible NPCs can find it.
top_creatures.keep: Start-invisible flag with a higher XP weight; a become-invisible move.
top_creatures.change: Our reveal rule and tell (a shimmer).

top_creatures.label: Mixed ambush group
top_creatures.why: Three families arrive together as one scripted encounter.
top_creatures.keep: A mixed group as one encounter.
top_creatures.change: Our families and our order of arrival.

top_creatures.label: Per-creature trait card
top_creatures.why: A short list of true/false traits per creature (sleep-safe, charm-safe, curse-safe, poison-safe, cannot-die, splits, summons, teleports, invisible, plus an attack mode).
top_creatures.keep: Booleans per creature from a fixed list.
top_creatures.change: Our trait names and a cap of three traits per creature for readability.

weapon_families: Use tiers: melee, poor throw, good throw, missile-firing (shapes/shapeinf/weaponinf.h uses field)
Power flags: sleep, paralyse, charm, poison, curse, no-damage (shapes/shapeinf/weaponinf.cc get_base_strength, from line 63)
Behaviour flags: lucky, explodes, returns, autohit, no-blocking, delete-when-depleted, needs-target (shapes/shapeinf/weaponinf.h)
Strength is a point budget per power; autohit doubles it. Source calls its weights guesses (weaponinf.cc:64)

looks.label: Neighbour-joined blob edges
looks.technique: Each blob reads its four neighbours and sets bits in its frame index so edges join; a random low bit adds variety.

looks.label: Probabilistic bleed trail
looks.technique: A 1-in-6 chance on move drops a blood decal on the old tile, using a fixed frame range.

looks.label: Sparkle rain over fog
looks.technique: Particle class built on a shape, layered over a fog palette shift.

looks.label: Explosion sprite sequence
looks.technique: Frame sequence on a timed sprite effect.

looks.label: Engraved material title font
looks.technique: One glyph set re-coloured as wood, metal, gold and a serpent variant (names only, not viewed).

looks.label: Paperdoll slot layers
looks.technique: One shape layer per equipment slot following body frames, so an item swaps without redrawing the body (names only).

looks.label: Glowing self-lit item
looks.technique: Item with a glow look; technique not read (name only).

originals.name: Splitting jelly with a fight budget
originals.idea: A jelly that splits when struck, with a fight-wide cap and a visible size tier.
originals.keep: Split-on-hit, neighbour-joined blob frames, bleed trail.
originals.change: Cap per fight tied to row 23 spawn caps, our size tiers, our sound.

originals.name: Winged stone family
originals.idea: Worker, warrior and noble tiers plus a flying variant, one silhouette per tier.
originals.change: Our names, wing shape and palette.

originals.name: Drake age ladder with undead form
originals.idea: Baby, adult, elder and one skeletal variant.

originals.name: Creature trait card
originals.idea: Up to three traits per creature from a fixed list (cannot-die, splits, summons, teleports, invisible, plus a bias).
originals.change: Our trait names and the three-trait cap.

originals.name: Weapon power budget
originals.idea: A point budget per power; autohit and explosive as flags with costs.
originals.keep: Budget per power; autohit as a flag.
originals.change: Our numbers, tuned in our own data (the source calls its weights guesses).

originals.name: Returning throw axe
originals.idea: A thrown axe with a return flight and four use tiers (melee, poor throw, good throw, missile).
originals.keep: Return flight and the use tiers.

originals.name: Fog with sparkle rain
originals.idea: A fog zone with a sparkle particle layer over a palette shift for one biome.

originals.name: Engraved title font
originals.idea: One glyph set in three material looks for HUD titles, each with a dark rim and one bright top highlight.
